body: Create a production compositing asset, one isolated architectural miniature, on a genuinely transparent background. Reference image is a style / object design reference ONLY. Reproduce the beautiful black, antique brass and warm ivory enterprise miniature in the RIGHT panel: a three level contemporary pavilion with stepped pitched dark roofs, amber illuminated glass central atrium, fine black mullions, fine brass trim, a diagonal exterior staircase on the RIGHT, and square dark base with small restrained plants. Three-quarter front view looking slightly down, same perspective as reference. It must have rich photographic miniature materials, fine but legible detail, realistic warm interior lighting, golden highlights and substantial dark mass, no thin wireframe. IMPORTANT for animation: OMIT ONLY the small uppermost pitched rooftop cap at the very top. Leave a neat open rectangular attic / roof seat for this final cap to be lowered onto later; all lower pitched roofs and the complete building body stay. The missing cap belongs to the top small storey, not the whole roof. No hand, person, lens, floor, tabletop, background, labels, text or cast shadow on a surrounding plane. Full building and base, no cropping, centered with 10% transparent margins. Large square 2048x2048 PNG if possible. Transparent alpha, not checkerboard painted into pixels.
background: Create a cinematic portrait 9:16 EMPTY architect's workshop environment clean plate for layering a miniature model into a film. Reference is ONLY the black antique gold photographic mood, not its contents. Large walnut workbench occupies bottom 45% with convincing perspective, fine warm wood texture and one open ivory architectural blueprint with faint NON-TEXT fine schematic lines lying mostly flat, plain uncluttered central area wide enough for a large miniature model. Background is a beautiful dark studio with out of focus black brass shelving, warm small desk lamp at far left, tall soft amber window glow on right. Eye-level camera slightly above tabletop, looking down about 15 degrees. Cinematic low key warm lighting, rich blacks, tangible materials, no heavy haze, no fireworks or floating particles. Upper 30% extremely dark smooth negative space for later typesetting. Lower 12% mostly dark walnut for later subtitles. In the CENTER do NOT put any building, object, human, lens, hand, roof, sculpture or machinery; completely empty model landing area. No text, logos, typography, border or multi-panel layout. High quality full bleed photography, 1080x1920 or larger portrait. Composition supports a slow digital dolly backward, so leave generous safe edges.
roof: Create ONE isolated small pitched rooftop CAP compositing asset on genuinely transparent background. This asset is the missing top roof that fits into the open rectangular gold rim at the very TOP of the reference miniature. Match exact perspective: three-quarter view, looking down about 15 degrees; front long side slopes down toward viewer, right end visible, rear ridge rises toward upper left. Black ribbed metal pitched roof with warm brass perimeter and ridge, high craft physical miniature photographed in warm studio lighting. ONLY that uppermost little rooftop cap, no walls, no room, no base, no building, no person, no labels or text. It will be animated downward onto that reference building. Compact rectangular hip/gable roof, width about 2.7 times its projected image height. Horizontally centered in a landscape canvas, full asset with transparent margin, all edges sharp and clean. Rich detailed roof ribs, restrained warm reflections, neutral black underside. True alpha transparency. Do not change the rest of the building because no building should appear in this output.
observer: Create a photographic compositing foreground character cutout on genuine transparent background for a black and antique gold architectural research workshop. A thoughtful adult observer seen very close from BEHIND and in THREE-QUARTER BACK profile, positioned on the RIGHT edge of a portrait image, looking left slightly downward at a model on a table. Only the back/side of head, one ear, neck, and dark charcoal textured coat shoulder/chest visible. Face mostly hidden, no recognizable public person. A delicate warm gold rim light on left edges of hair and cheek and coat, very dark shadows with rich photographic detail. Small elegant black spectacle arm near the ear, tasteful scholarly clothing, not a lab coat. Head occupies upper right, broad shoulder slopes down to lower right. LEFT half of image entirely transparent, no arm reaching across frame. Crop naturally through torso at bottom, no detached hand. No lens, building, desk, floor, background, text or props. The observer will be a slightly defocused foreground layer, so keep restrained contrast. High-end cinematic photography, vertical 2:3 composition.
